description: F-DATA contains job-level workload records from the Fugaku supercomputer, published by researchers at the University of Bologna and RIKEN. More than 24 million jobs from March 2021 through April 2024 are organised in 38 monthly Parquet files. The documented features describe job duration and exit status, power and performance, memory behaviour and derived compute- or memory-bound labels. A CSV feature list accompanies the deposit. Zenodo provides the data for free under CC BY 4.0. The companion GitHub repository contains Python loading examples, predictive-modelling baselines, plotting code and scripts for anonymisation and derived features; a software licence was not identified there. These observations can calibrate scheduling, capacity planning and energy-demand simulations for data centres. They complement data-cineca-marconi-examon-telemetry and the modelling purposes of platform-exadigit. Coverage is one supercomputer and its operational workload, with job-level summaries, not a uniform time-series sample interval. A caveat is that anonymisation and machine-specific architecture limit reconstruction of individual applications and transfer to other computing facilities.
